title: matlatl trails.json
description: Suggested reading orders (associative trails, Bush 1945) emitted by `matlatl emit --out <dir>`. Each trail is a topologically-valid reading order for one weakly-connected component of the doc graph, rooted at the component's most important (highest-PageRank) document and preferring higher-authority docs among the available frontier (ADR 0016). This schema is the published contract; the emitter type internal/infrastructure/emit/trails.Document is kept in lockstep and a test validates emitted bytes against this document.

root.description: The cluster's most-important document: its highest-PageRank member (ties broken by smallest DocumentID). This is an IMPORTANCE pointer, NOT the first doc to read — the root may appear anywhere in `order` (a high-importance sink is topologically late).

order.description: The full topological reading sequence of the cluster's documents over the SCC condensation, tie-broken by PageRank (higher-PageRank docs are preferred among the currently-available frontier). The `root` may appear anywhere in this list, not necessarily first.
